name: VLB
recent: VLB 完成约 9443 万股私募新股发行，发行价 RM0.70，新股已于 2026 年 9 月 11 日上市。同期公司获得一项价值 RM263 million 的建筑合约。最新季度营收环比增长 25.4%，净利环比增长 47.9%。
notable: 完成私募配售，发行 94,430,800 股新股，发行价 RM0.70，新股于 2026 年 9 月 11 日上市。
获得一项价值 RM263 million 的建筑合约。
首席财务官 Low Choon Wei 与合约总经理 Ooi Yiqing 各于 2026 年 9 月 7 日出售 150,000 股普通股。
risks: 私募配售新股占发行前股本约 10%，对现有股东持股比例有摊薄影响。
首席财务官及合约总经理在公开市场出售股份。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 RM250.241 million，环比增长 25.4%，同比增长 17.4%；净利为 RM11.948 million，环比增长 47.9%，同比增长 11.8%；净利率为 4.8%，高于上一季度的 4.1%。

recent_en: VLB completed a private placement of about 94.43 million new shares at RM0.70, with the shares listed on 11 September 2026. The company also secured a RM263 million construction contract. Latest quarterly revenue rose 25.4% QoQ and net profit rose 47.9% QoQ.
notable_en: Completed a private placement of 94,430,800 new shares at RM0.70, listed on 11 September 2026.
Secured a RM263 million construction contract.
Chief Financial Officer Low Choon Wei and General Manager of Contracts Ooi Yiqing each disposed of 150,000 ordinary shares on 7 September 2026.
risks_en: The private placement of new shares represents about 10% of the pre-issuance share base, diluting existing shareholders' stakes.
The Chief Financial Officer and General Manager of Contracts sold shares in the open market.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM250.241 million, up 25.4% QoQ and 17.4% YoY; net profit was RM11.948 million, up 47.9% QoQ and 11.8% YoY; net margin was 4.8%, up from 4.1% in the previous quarter.
